title: The effect of accelerated pulsed high-fluence corneal cross-linking on corneal endothelium; a prospective specular microscopy study

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>); CC0 waiver applies to data made available in the article

indication: Mild to moderate progressive keratoconus (Kmax below 56 D, thinnest pachymetry above 400 µm); epithelium-off accelerated pulsed high-fluence CXL (KXL, 30 mW/cm2 UVA, 8 min pulsed 1 s on/1 s off, 7.2 J/cm2, riboflavin 0.1% in HPMC)

groups.description: Single-arm prospective case series (45 eyes of 27 patients) treated with pulsed-light accelerated CXL; no comparator arm

series.baseline_label: Preoperative non-contact specular microscopy (Nidek CEM-530) of the treated eye
series.notes: Table 2 row 'Endothelial cell density', mean ± SD at preoperative, 3 months and 6 months postoperatively; analysed by repeated-measures ANOVA; the table gives no per-visit n

exclusions.reason: same preoperative mean as Tab2 R2C2 (with range); Table 2 carries the follow-up

notes: Single-arm case series of a standard CXL procedure context without a declared experimental arm; recorded as control.
